en.hubeali: H 14980 – Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Walladin, and someone else from our companions, who have reported the following: Abu Abdullahasws
regarding the Statement of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic: “[22:25] and whoever shall incline therein to wrong unjustly, We will make him taste of a painful chastisement”,

so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who worships other than Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, or befriends other than the Guardians<sup>asws</sup> from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so he has inclined to injustice
and it is upon Allahazwj Blessed and High to make him taste of a painful chastisement”.
en.sarwar: 534. Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ja’far Al-Howl, from Sallam Bin Al-Mustaneer, who has reported the following:

Abu Ja’far (a.s.) regarding the Statement of Allah (azwj) Blessed and High: “[22:40] Those who have been expelled from their homes without a just cause except that they say: Our Lord is Allah”. He (a.s.) said: ‘It was Revealed regarding the Rasool Allah (saww), and Ali (a.s.), and Hamza (ar), and Ja’far (ar), and it flowed regarding Al-Husayn (a.s.), may Peace be upon all of them’.
